input.quote: (c) ASSIGNMENT. Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
input.rationale:
The assignment clause (p0149) is a one-way, blanket prohibition on Licensee assignment with no affiliate or M&A carve-out and no reasonableness standard on Licensor's consent, while imposing no corresponding restriction on Licensor. Article XX (p0134) compounds this by automatically terminating the Agreement and all of our licenses on our Change of Control unless Licensor consents in advance, with Licensor deemed reasonable in refusing whenever it merely believes its interests may be adversely affected. That is walk-away territory under the rule (blanket customer assignment ban with no M&A carve-out plus a vendor termination right on our change of control) and fails both the preferred and fallback positions. The redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out, makes the consent standard mutual and not unreasonably withheld, bars assignment by Licensor to our competitor, and removes the change-of-control termination trigger (retaining notice to Licensor and the existing Change of Control definition).</rationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.9

proposal.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Licensee, make consent standard mutual and reasonable, and remove automatic termination on Licensee change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need to be able to assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets without Licensor consent, and our change of control cannot be an automatic termination trigger; we have made the consent standard mutual and reasonable in exchange. If helpful, we can accept mutual assignment to successors on written notice with consent not unreasonably withheld for other assignments.

ops.oldText: Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
ops.newText: Licensee may assign this Agreement and its rights hereunder, in whole or in part, without Licensor's consent, to an Affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, consolidation, reorganization, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or equity. Otherwise, neither party may assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its rights hereunder in whole or in part without the other party's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed, and Licensor may not in any event assign this Agreement to a competitor of Licensee.

ops.oldText: (a) Upon the occurrence of any Change of Control (as defined below) this Agreement and all Licensee's rights and licenses hereunder shall automatically terminate unless, prior to the occurrence of such Change of Control, Licensor has consented to such Change of Control in a writing executed by an officer of Licensor; provided that Licensor will not unreasonably withhold its consent to the consummation of a Change of Control. For purposes of the preceding sentence, Licensor will be deemed to have reasonably withheld its consent to a Change of Control if any person or entity who would acquire direct or indirect control (as defined below) of Licensee pursuant to such Change of Control then conducts a business that is directly or indirectly competitive with a business then conducted by Licensor or any of its Affiliates and/or Licensor reasonably believes that Licensor's interests will be adversely effected by the continuing of this Agreement upon such a Change in Control.
ops.newText: (a) A Change of Control (as defined below) of Licensee shall not require Licensor's consent and shall not give Licensor any right to terminate, suspend, re-price or otherwise modify this Agreement or Licensee's rights and licenses hereunder; Licensee shall give Licensor written notice of any Change of Control promptly following its consummation.
